svg.data-connector-options: { style: None, crossing: Bridge, minimum_approach: 24, corner_radius: 8, bridge_radius: 5, style_supplied_bpmn: false, limits: { candidates: 2000000, subdivisions: 200000, segments: 100000, crossings: 10000, output_units: 16777216, }, }
svg.title: ISO date with optional time
svg.desc: Railroad diagram of the regular expression (?<year>\d{4})-(?<month>0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?<day>\d{2})(?:T\d{2}:\d{2})?(?!\d) with 14 terms. It shows structure; it does not match input.
